def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.array([[1.0 * (s == l) for l in labs[1:]] for s in feats.stratum]).reshape(n, -1)
    base = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), S])

    def ll(Z):
        b = np.zeros(Z.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30); mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); w = mu * (1 - mu) + 1e-9
            H = Z.T @ (Z * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, Z.T @ (y - mu)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-8: break
        mu = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(mu) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - mu)))

    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False)
    alpha = 0.01 / p
    sel = []
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        Z0 = np.column_stack([base] + [X[:, j] for j in sel]); l0 = ll(Z0)
        best, bp = None, alpha
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, k]) >= 0.6 for k in sel): continue
            pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (ll(np.column_stack([Z0, X[:, j]])) - l0), 1)
            if pv < bp: best, bp = j, pv
        if best is None: break
        nb = np.abs(R[best]) >= 0.6
        nb = (np.abs(R[nb]) >= 0.6).any(0)
        cl = [k for k in range(p) if nb[k] and k not in sel and not any(abs(R[k, q]) >= 0.6 for q in sel)]
        def resid(c):
            Zc = np.column_stack([Z0, X[:, c]]); lc = ll(Zc)
            return sum(2 * (ll(np.column_stack([Zc, X[:, m]])) - lc) for m in cl if m != c)
        sel.append(min(cl, key=resid) if len(cl) > 1 else best)
    keep = []
    for j in sel:
        others = [k for k in sel if k != j]
        Z0 = np.column_stack([base] + [X[:, k] for k in others])
        pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (ll(np.column_stack([Z0, X[:, j]])) - ll(Z0)), 1)
        if pv < alpha: keep.append(j)
    Zk = np.column_stack([base] + [X[:, k] for k in keep]); lk = ll(Zk)
    prods, palpha = [], 0.002 / (p * (p - 1) / 2)
    bpair, bp = None, palpha
    for a in range(p):
        for c in range(a + 1, p):
            Z1 = np.column_stack([Zk, X[:, a], X[:, c], X[:, a] * X[:, c]])
            Zm = np.column_stack([Zk, X[:, a], X[:, c]])
            pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (ll(Z1) - ll(Zm)), 1)
            if pv < bp: bpair, bp = (a, c), pv
    drivers = [ids[j] for j in keep]
    if bpair is not None:
        a, c = bpair
        prods.append((ids[a], ids[c]))
        for j in (a, c):
            if ids[j] not in drivers and len(drivers) < MAX_DRIVERS: drivers.append(ids[j])
    cols = list(dict.fromkeys(drivers))
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=tuple(cols), products=tuple(prods), loadings={})
